# AI usage strategy
Mode: NORMAL. Remaining usage: unknown; no subscription telemetry is available.
- Normal: ChatGPT coordinates; recommend Claude specialists and Codex implementation; independent approved work may proceed concurrently.
- LOW (user says Low usage): identify active independent Claude candidates, prepare complete GitHub handoffs, update board and rank candidates. Preserve ChatGPT for coordination/integration/critical decisions; short responses and no repeated analysis.
- CRITICAL (Claude priority / extremely low): CLAUDE PRIORITY MODE. Prepare several independent Claude proposals where useful; avoid large new ChatGPT implementation tasks; preserve essential docs before handoff.
- RECOVERY (Usage reset): inspect external commits and PRs, review completed tasks, identify unfinished work, update roadmap and return to NORMAL without repeating work.
No automatic AI switch or assignment: user approval controls transfers. Recommendations consider complexity, expected reasoning, effort, context, workload, usage and independent review. Subscription/model claims require verified information.
